name: FileTrigger
summary: Opens a native file picker and reports selected files.

useWhen: Selecting one or more local files
A clearly named picker, alone for compact selection or inside a DropZone for an upload area
avoidWhen: Receiving files by drag and drop; use DropZone
Uploading, tracking, or retrying files; FileTrigger only reports the selection, and the application owns the transfer

obligations: Expose a keyboard-operable file picker trigger.
Keep the native input hidden from the visual layout while retaining its native picker semantics.

behavior: onSelect receives the selected files as an array of File objects.
acceptedFileTypes sets the native accept attribute, which narrows what the picker offers.
allowsMultiple lets the picker select more than one file.
acceptDirectory sets the native webkitdirectory attribute.
defaultCamera, user or environment, sets the native capture attribute.
Pressing the trigger resets the native input first, so choosing the same file again calls onSelect.
FileTrigger uploads nothing, and a form does not submit the chosen files.
A disabled FileTrigger disables its trigger and does not call onSelect.
accessibility: Keep activation on the consumer trigger and preserve its accessible name.
Apply disabled behavior to the trigger while retaining the native input as a hidden implementation detail.
